## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r load-data}

# download details
aggregated_data <- readRDS("../data/scratch/aggregated_data.RDS") 
cosy_hp_details <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_cosy_details_2024_07_24.csv") %>%
  inner_join(aggregated_data %>% select(hashed_mpan) %>% distinct()) %>%
  distinct() 
cosy_hp_details <- cosy_hp_details %>% 
  filter(!is.na(property_value), !is.na(floor_area), !is.na(energy_efficiency))
rm(aggregated_data)

# get consumption by period
hp_details <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_hp_aggregated_up_2024_06_18.csv") %>%
  distinct(account_id, hashed_mpan) %>%
  inner_join(fread("../data/input/cosy_-_hp_details_2024_06_25.csv") %>% distinct(account_id), by=c("account_id","hashed_mpan")) %>%
  filter(installed_at <= "2024-05-29")

random_domus_sample <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_random_sample_details_2024_08_23.csv") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(property_value), !is.na(floor_area), !is.na(energy_efficiency))
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Identify common variables across datasets (excluding account_id and hashed_mpan)
common_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  setdiff(names(cosy_hp_details), c("account_id", "hashed_mpan")),
  setdiff(names(hp_details), c("account_id", "hashed_mpan")),
  setdiff(names(random_domus_sample), c("account_id", "hashed_mpan"))
))

# Separate numeric and categorical variables
numeric_vars <- cosy_hp_details %>%
  select(all_of(common_vars)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

categorical_vars <- setdiff(common_vars, numeric_vars)

# Function to summarize numeric variables
summarise_numeric <- function(data, prefix) {
  data %>%
    select(all_of(numeric_vars)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), 
                     list(mean = ~mean(. , na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)), 
                     .names = paste0(prefix, "_{col}_{.fn}")))
}

# Summarise numeric variables for each dataset
cosy_numeric <- summarise_numeric(cosy_hp_details, "Cosy")
hp_numeric <- summarise_numeric(hp_details, "HP")
random_numeric <- summarise_numeric(random_domus_sample, "Random")

# Pivot each dataset separately and then bind columns with unique names
cosy_numeric_long <- cosy_numeric %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "Cosy_(.*)_(.*)")

hp_numeric_long <- hp_numeric %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "HP_(.*)_(.*)")

random_numeric_long <- random_numeric %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "Random_(.*)_(.*)")

# Combine numeric summaries into a single table
numeric_summary <- cosy_numeric_long %>%
  full_join(hp_numeric_long, by = "Variable") %>%
  full_join(random_numeric_long, by = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(
    Cosy = paste0(round(mean.x, 2), " (", round(sd.x, 2), ")"),
    HP = paste0(round(mean.y, 2), " (", round(sd.y, 2), ")"),
    Random = paste0(round(mean, 2), " (", round(sd, 2), ")")
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Cosy, HP, Random)

# Display the summary table
numeric_summary

# Function to summarize categorical variables with proportions and SD
summarize_categorical <- function(data, prefix) {
  data %>%
    select(all_of(categorical_vars)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), 
                     ~ {
                       tbl <- table(factor(.))
                       prop <- prop.table(tbl) * 100
                       n <- sum(tbl)
                       sd <- sqrt((prop / 100) * (1 - prop / 100) / n) * 100
                       list(Proportion = prop, SD = sd)
                     }, 
                     .names = "{col}")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Proportion") %>%
    unnest(Proportion) %>%
    mutate(Category = names(Proportion), Proportion = round(Proportion, 2),
           Category = ifelse(Category=="", "Missing", Category),
           Sample = prefix)
}


# Summarize categorical variables for each dataset
cosy_categorical <- summarize_categorical(cosy_hp_details, "Cosy")
hp_categorical <- summarize_categorical(hp_details, "HP")
random_categorical <- summarize_categorical(random_domus_sample, "Random")

```
``` {r}


# Identify common variables across datasets (excluding account_id and hashed_mpan)
common_vars <- c("energy_efficiency", "floor_area", "property_value")

# Separate numeric variables
numeric_vars <- cosy_hp_details %>%
  select(all_of(common_vars)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

# Function to summarize numeric variables (mean and standard error)
summarise_numeric <- function(data, prefix) {
  data %>%
    select(all_of(numeric_vars)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), 
                     list(mean = ~mean(. , na.rm = TRUE), 
                          sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)), 
                     .names = paste0(prefix, "_{col}_{.fn}")))
}

# Summarise numeric variables for each dataset
cosy_numeric <- summarise_numeric(cosy_hp_details, "Cosy")
hp_numeric <- summarise_numeric(hp_details, "HP")
random_numeric <- summarise_numeric(random_domus_sample, "Random")

# Pivot each dataset separately to a long format
cosy_numeric_long <- cosy_numeric %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "Cosy_(.*)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(Sample = "Cosy")

hp_numeric_long <- hp_numeric %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "HP_(.*)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(Sample = "HP")

random_numeric_long <- random_numeric %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "Random_(.*)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(Sample = "Random")

# Combine all summaries
numeric_summary <- rbind(cosy_numeric_long, hp_numeric_long, random_numeric_long)

# Pivot to get a wide format with separate columns for each sample (Cosy, HP, Random)
final_table <- numeric_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = c(mean, sd)) %>%
  arrange(Variable)


# Function to format numbers with a comma separator and two decimal places
format_number <- function(x) {
  formatC(x, format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 2)
}

# Create a table with separate rows for mean and sd
final_table_with_sd <- final_table %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_Cosy, mean_HP, mean_Random, sd_Cosy, sd_HP, sd_Random), 
               names_to = c("Statistic", "Sample"), 
               names_sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Statistic) %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", Variable, ""),
         Cosy = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", 
                       format_number(Cosy), 
                       paste0("(", format_number(Cosy), ")")),
         HP = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", 
                     format_number(HP), 
                     paste0("(", format_number(HP), ")")),
         Random = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", 
                         format_number(Random), 
                         paste0("(", format_number(Random), ")"))) %>%
  select(Variable, Cosy, HP, Random) %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Variable != "", 
                           str_replace_all(Variable, "_", " ") %>% 
                             str_to_title(), 
                           Variable))

# Display the final table
final_table_with_sd

# Create the LaTeX table using stargazer
library(stargazer)
stargazer(final_table_with_sd, type = "latex", summary = FALSE, 
          title = "External Validity by Area for \textit{Cosy} and Heat Pump Adopters",
          rownames = FALSE,
          digits = 2,
          label = "tab:cosy-hp-random",
          out = "../tables/balance_table_cosy_hp_random.tex")
```
```{r}

# cosy sample
aggregated_data <- readRDS("../data/scratch/aggregated_data.RDS") 

# download details for 1000 surveyed
survey_selection <- fread("../data/input/cosy_survey_ids.csv")

# gather all responders
responders <- fread("../data/input/survey_ids.csv")

# download domus variables
cosy_hp_details <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_cosy_details_2024_07_24.csv") %>%
  inner_join(aggregated_data%>% distinct(hashed_mpan, account_id))

cosy_survey <- cosy_hp_details %>%
  filter(account_id %in% responders$account_id) %>%
  select(-account_id) %>%
  distinct() 

cosy_non_survey <- survey_selection %>%
  filter(!account_id %in% responders$account_id) %>%
  inner_join(cosy_hp_details)


rm(aggregated_data, cosy_hp_details, survey_responses, responders, survey_selection)

# Summarise numeric variables for each dataset
cosy_survey_numeric <- summarise_numeric(cosy_survey, "Survey")
cosy_non_survey_numeric <- summarise_numeric(cosy_non_survey, "NoSurvey")

# Pivot each dataset separately to a long format
cosy_survey_numeric_long <- cosy_survey_numeric %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), 
               names_pattern = "Survey_(.*)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(Sample = "Survey")

cosy_non_survey_numeric_long <- cosy_non_survey_numeric %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), 
               names_pattern = "NoSurvey_(.*)_(.*)") %>%
  mutate(Sample = "NoSurvey")

# Combine all summaries
numeric_summary <- rbind(cosy_survey_numeric_long, cosy_non_survey_numeric_long)

# Pivot to get a wide format with separate columns for each sample (Cosy, HP, Random)
final_table <- numeric_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = c(mean, sd)) %>%
  arrange(Variable)

# Create a table with separate rows for mean and sd
final_table_with_sd <- final_table %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_Survey, mean_NoSurvey,  sd_Survey, sd_NoSurvey), 
               names_to = c("Statistic", "Sample"), 
               names_sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Statistic) %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", Variable, ""),
         Survey = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", 
                       format_number(Survey), 
                       paste0("(", format_number(Survey), ")")),
         NoSurvey = ifelse(Statistic == "mean", 
                     format_number(NoSurvey), 
                     paste0("(", format_number(NoSurvey), ")"))) %>%
  select(Variable, Survey, NoSurvey) %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Variable != "", 
                           str_replace_all(Variable, "_", " ") %>% 
                             str_to_title(), 
                           Variable))

# Display the final table
final_table_with_sd

# Create the LaTeX table using stargazer
library(stargazer)
stargazer(final_table_with_sd, type = "latex", summary = FALSE, 
          title = "Balance Table for \textit{Cosy} Survey Responders and Non-Responders",
          rownames = FALSE,
          digits = 2,
          label = "tab:cosy-survey-stats",
          out = "../tables/balance_table_cosy_survey.tex")

```
